LESSON + ROUTE (orchestrator, 2026-09-04 07:55 EDT). Three first verifications failed and are in audit; the code held in every case, the contracts did not.
41r.2 (absent spec-meta): all three mutations behave, crash-to-finding confirmed across main, e18fa05 and HEAD, all six tasks clean; the Gap is that the `checked subjects=` line has a second emitter, Ancora.validate/2 at lib/ancora.ex:56, which still counts files, so spec.check prints 0 and spec.validate prints 1 on the same fixture while the new must sentences say "each corpus-reading Mix task". lib/ancora.ex is outside the Allowed list; the auditor decides between scoping the sentences to spec.check and a scope grant.
41r.5 (override key): everything proves both ways and the finding cannot be silenced by severities or a trailer; the Gap is that the must says "any other entry key" and both tests use only `requirement`: a parser that rejects that one literal and drops the rest silently passes all 40 tests. One fixture line.
41r.1 (git paths): two gaps and a critic FAIL. The derive sentence "callers shall tag paths and object ids" is false in the commit that ships it because BaseView (out of scope, kzw) still passes a bare OID; and behavior 1's named mutation (space-split cat-file parse) is no longer reachable from the CLI once prefetch resolves paths to OIDs, so only the unit test kills it while the contract named the CLI. Critic: PATH mutated via System.put_env in an async: true module (latent race across eight git-touching modules), and drift asserted by code membership only, never by file, in a ticket whose bug class is a path stored under the wrong name.
41r.3 critic FAIL (below-tip fold ordering undiscriminated) is with its verifier; 41r.4 critic PASS, verifier running.

LESSONS
- [stale-spec] Before writing "callers shall X" into a subject, enumerate the callers in that subject's Modules block and run one; a sentence that is false at the commit that ships it is the exact defect this epic exists to remove. (from 41r.1)
- [untested-clause] When an architectural fix makes the named mutation unreachable from the ordered entry point, say so in the completion record and repoint the proof; do not report the unit-test kill as if it were the CLI kill. (from 41r.1)
- [untested-clause] A must phrased "any other X" needs a fixture with an X that is not the one the bug report named; one literal key proves the literal. (from 41r.5)
- [stale-spec] A sentence about an output line must be true for every emitter of that line; grep for the literal before writing "each task". (from 41r.2)
- [other] Tests that rewrite PATH or any process-global for a subprocess run belong in async: false modules, as git_test.exs already does. (from 41r.1 critic)
